title: 第4章本座的堂弟
slug: 二哈和他的白猫师尊皓衣行
content_zh:
此师昧非彼师妹。
师昧乃是如假包换的男子，且论入门时间，他还是墨燃的师兄。
之所以取了这么个倒霉名字，全赖死生之巅的尊主没学识。
师昧原本是个孤儿，是被尊主在野外捡回来的，这孩子打小体弱多病，尊主就寻思着，得给这娃儿取个贱名，贱名好养活。
小孩生的唇红齿白，像个挺招人疼爱的小丫头，于是尊主绞尽脑汁，给人家想了个名字，叫薛丫。
薛丫越长越大，越长越俊，盘靓条顺的，眉梢眼角都是风情，颇有些风华绝代的韵味儿。
乡野村夫顶着薛丫这名字没问题，但是见过绝色佳人叫“狗蛋”“铁柱”的吗？
同门师兄弟们觉得不妥，渐渐的就不叫人家薛丫了，但是尊主取的名字，他们又不好去更改，于是就半开玩笑地管人家叫师妹。
师妹长师妹短的，后来尊主干脆大手一挥，善解人意地说：“薛丫，你干脆改个名儿，就叫师昧吧，蒙昧的昧，怎么样？”
还好意思问怎么样…正常人哪儿受的了这驴名字？但师昧脾气好，他抬眼看了看尊主，发现对方正喜滋滋兴冲冲地瞧着他，敢情还以为自己做了件天大的好事呢。师昧不忍心，觉得就算自己委屈，也不能扫了尊主大人的颜面。于是欣然跪谢，从此改名换姓。
“咳咳。”黑斗篷呛了几声，才缓过气儿来，抬眼去看墨燃，“嗯？阿燃？你怎么在这里？”
隔着一层朦胧纱帘，那双眼睛柔若春水，灿若星辰，直直地就剜进了墨燃心底。
就一眼，踏仙君蒙尘已久的那些个柔情蜜意、少男心事，都在瞬间解封。
是师昧。
错不了。
墨燃是个流氓胚子，上辈子，玩过很多男男女女，最后居然不是死于精尽人亡，他自己也颇感意外。
但是他唯一掏心窝子去喜欢的那个人，他却小心翼翼地，从来不敢轻易触碰。
那些年，他和师昧两个人风花雪月地暧昧着，但到师昧死，墨燃也就牵过人家的手，连嘴也只误打误撞亲一次。
墨燃觉得自个儿脏，师昧太温柔纯净，他配不上。
这个人活着都已经让他如此珍惜，更别提死去之后。那就彻底成了踏仙君心口的白月光，任凭他抓心挠肝地惦记，斯人已成一抔黄土，九泉之下，仙踪难觅。

然而此时此刻，活生生的师昧又出现在他面前，墨燃不得不用尽浑身气力，才忍住自己激动不已的情绪。
墨燃把人扶起来，替他掸去斗篷上的尘土，心疼得直掉肉。
“我要不在这里，你还得被他们欺负成什么样？别人打你，怎么不还手？”
“我想先讲道理……”
“跟这些人还讲什么道理！伤着了吧？哪里疼？”
“咳咳，阿燃，我……我不碍事。”
墨燃转头，面目凶恶地朝那几个道士说：“死生之巅的人，你们也敢动手？胆子大得很啊。”
“阿燃……算了吧……”
“你们不是要打吗？来啊！何不跟我过过招！”
那几个道士被墨燃一掌拍到，已知道此人修为远在自己之上，他们都是吃软怕硬的，哪里敢和墨燃对招，纷纷后退。
师昧连连叹气，劝道：“阿燃，莫要争了，得饶人处且饶人吧。”
墨燃回头看他，不由得心酸楚，眼眶微热。
师昧从来都是如此心善，上辈子死的时候，也毫无怨怼，并无恨意。甚至还劝墨燃，不要去记恨那个明明可以救他一命，却偏袖手旁观的师尊。
“可是他们……”
“我这不是好好的，也没事吗？多一事不如少一事，听师哥的。”
“唉唉，好吧，听你的，都听你的。”墨燃摇摇头，瞪了那几个道士一眼，“听到没有？我师哥替你们求情了！还不快滚？杵在这里，还要我送你们不成？”
“是是是！我们这就滚！这就滚！”
师昧对那几个道士说：“慢着。”
那几个人觉得师昧刚刚被他们一通暴揍，觉得他估计是不会轻易放过自己，跪在地上连连磕头：“仙君、仙君我们错了，我们有眼不识泰山。求仙君放过我们！”
“方才我好好跟你们说，你们偏不听。”师昧叹息道，“你们把别人的孩子掳去，遭这样的罪过，让他们的爹娘心如刀割，良心可过意得去？”

“过意不去！过意不去！仙君，我们错了！再也不敢了！再也不敢了！”
“你们往后要清正做人，不可再行歹事，可都知道了？”
“是！仙君教训的是！我们、我们受教了，受教了！”
“既然这样，就请几位去和这位夫人道个歉，再好生医治她的孩子们吧。”
这事儿就算摆平了，墨燃扶师昧上马，自己则在驿馆借了另一匹，两人并辔缓行，返回门派。
吴钩高悬，月光穿林透叶，洒在林间小路上。
走着走着，墨燃渐渐美滋滋起来：他原以为至少要回到死生之巅，才能再见到师昧，没料到师昧下山扶道，正巧让他撞上，墨燃愈发相信，他和师昧果然是有缘分的。
虽说这个时候，师昧还没和自己在一起，但是上辈子都勾搭过了，这辈子显然也是驾轻就熟，水到渠成的事儿。
他唯一需要忧心的，就是保护好师昧，不要让他再像当年那样，惨死在自己怀……
师昧不知道墨燃已是重生之人，一如往日般和他聊着天。两人聊着聊着就到了死生之巅脚下。
谁料到深更半夜的，山门前却立着个人，正虎视眈眈地盯着他们。
“墨燃！你还知道回来？？”
“哎？”
墨燃一抬眼，哟呵，好一位怒气冲冲的天之骄子啊。
这个人不是别人，正是年轻时候的薛蒙。
比起临死之前看到的那个薛蒙，十五岁时的他，显得更加桀骜俊俏。一身黑底蓝边的轻简战甲，高马尾，银发扣，狮首腰带束着劲厉纤细的腰肢，护手腿扎一应俱全，背后一柄寒光璀璨的细窄弯刀，左臂上袖箭匣银光闪闪。
墨燃暗自叹口气，干脆利落地想：
嗯，骚。
薛蒙，无论少年时还是长大后，都真的很骚啊。
看看他，好好儿郎，大晚上的不睡觉，把死生之巅的全套战甲穿在身上，要干什么？表演雉鸡求偶孔雀开屏吗？

不过，墨燃不待见薛蒙，薛蒙也未必就待见他。
墨燃是私生子，小时候，他根本不知道自己父亲是谁，在湘潭的一处乐坊里打杂混日子。直到十四岁那年，才被家人寻回了死生之巅。
薛蒙则是死生之巅的少主，算起来，他其实是墨燃的堂弟。薛蒙少年早成，是个天才，人称“天之骄子”“凤凰儿”。一般人筑基三年，修成灵核最起码需要十年，薛蒙天资聪颖，从入门到灵核修成，前后不过五年时间，颇令父母欣喜，方赞誉。
但在墨燃眼里，不管他是凤凰还是鸡，是孔雀还是鸭，反正都是鸟。毛长毛短的区别而已。
于是墨燃看薛蒙：鸟玩意。
薛蒙看墨燃：狗东西。
或许是家族遗传，墨燃的天赋也十分惊人，甚至可以说，比薛蒙更惊人。
墨燃刚来的那会儿，薛蒙觉得自己特别高贵冷艳，修养好，有学识，功夫强，长得俊，和堂哥这种大字不识几个，吊儿郎当的臭流氓不是一路人。
于是自恋的凤凰儿哼哼唧唧的就指挥着随从，跟他们说：“你们听好了，墨燃这个人，游手好闲，不学无术，是个不折不扣的市井混混，你们统统不许搭理他，把这人当狗就好。”
随从们便谄媚道：“少主说的极是，那个墨燃都已经十四岁了，现在才开始修仙，我看他最起码得花上十年才能筑基，二十年才能结出灵核。到时候咱们少主都渡劫飞升了，他只能眼巴巴在地上看着。”
薛蒙得意地冷笑：“二十年？哼，我看他那废物模样，这辈子都修不出灵核。”
谁料到，废物嘻嘻哈哈地跟着师尊学了一年，竟然灵核大成。
凤凰儿顿时如遭雷击，觉得自己被打了脸，咽不下这口恶气。
于是暗地里扎他小人，咒人家御剑脚底打滑，念咒舌头打结。
每次见墨燃，薛蒙小凤凰更是要坚持不懈地赏给人家俩大白眼仁儿，鼻子里哼出的声音隔着三里地都能听到。
墨燃想到这些童年往事，忍不住眯着眼乐，他已经很久没有享受过这样的人间烟火了，孤独了十年，就连当年痛恨不已的事情，如今嚼起来也嘎巴脆响，香的很。
师昧见了薛蒙，当即下马，摘了黑纱斗笠，露出一张惊艳绝伦的脸来。
也无怪他单独出门要穿成这样，墨燃在旁边偷眼看着，就觉得心驰神摇，想入非非。心道这人实在是绝色之姿，慑魂取魄。
师昧和他打招呼：“少主。”
薛蒙点了点头：“回来了？人熊的事情处理妥当了？”

师昧微笑道：“妥当了。多亏遇到了阿燃，帮了我好大的忙。”
薛蒙傲然的眼光如疾风利刃一般，迅速在墨燃身上扫了一下，立刻转开了，他皱着眉头，满脸不屑，仿佛多看墨燃片刻都会脏了自己的双目。
“师昧，你先回去休息。以后少和他厮混，这是个偷鸡摸狗的东西，跟他在一起，是要学坏的。”
墨燃也不示弱，嘲笑道：“师昧不学我，难道学你？大晚上还衣冠楚楚全副武装，和一只鸟似的竖着尾巴臭美，还天之骄子……哈哈哈，我看是天之骄女吧？”
薛蒙勃然大怒：“墨燃，你把嘴给我放干净了！这是我家！你算老几？”
墨燃掐指一算：“我是你堂哥，论起来，应该排你前面。”
薛蒙仿佛被泼了一脸狗屎，立刻嫌恶地皱起眉头，厉声道：“谁有你这种堂哥！别给自己脸上贴金，在我眼里，你不过就是只泥潭里打过滚的狗！”
薛蒙这人特别喜欢骂别人是狗，什么狗儿子狗东西狗娘养的狗爹生的，上下嘴皮一碰骂得那叫一个纯熟。墨燃对此早就习惯了，掏掏耳朵，不以为意。倒是师昧在旁边听得尴尬，低声劝了几句。薛蒙总算是从鼻孔里冷哼一声，闭上了自己那张尊贵的鸟嘴。
师昧笑了笑，温温柔柔地问道：“少主这么晚了，在山门前等人？”
“不然呢？赏月吗？”
墨燃捧腹笑道：“我就说你怎么收拾的这么好看，原来是等人约会，哎，谁那么倒霉被你惦念上了？我好同情她啊，哈哈哈哈哈。”
薛蒙的脸更黑了，指甲一刮能掉三斤煤，他粗声恶气道：“你！”
“……我？”
“本公子等你，你待如何？”
墨燃：“……………………？？？”
content_en:
This teacher is not that junior sister.
Shi Mo is a real man, and when it comes to entry time, he is still Mo Ran's senior brother.
The reason why he had such an unfortunate name was because the Lord at the top of life and death was uneducated.
Shi Mo was originally an orphan who was picked up by the Lord in the wild. The child was weak and sick since he was a child, so the Lord thought that he should give the baby a nickname so that he could make a living.
The child had red lips and white teeth, making her look like a cute little girl, so the Lord racked his brains and came up with a name for her, Xue Ya.
Xue Ya grew bigger and bigger, and became more and more handsome. She had a pretty face and smooth hair, and her brows and eyes were full of amorous feelings, which gave her a certain charm of unparalleled elegance.
It's okay for a country man to bear the name Xue Ya, but have you ever seen a stunning beauty named "Goudan" or "Tiezhu"?
The fellow disciples felt it was inappropriate and gradually stopped calling her Xue Ya. However, it was difficult for them to change the name given by the Lord, so they half-jokingly called her junior sister.
The junior sister is older than the younger sister. Later, the Lord simply waved his hand and said considerately: "Xue Ya, why don't you just change my name to Shimo? I'm ignorant, what do you think?"
I still have the nerve to ask... How could a normal person tolerate such a donkey name? But Shi Mo had a good temper. He looked up at the Lord and found that the other person was looking at him with joy and excitement. He thought he had done a great deed. The teacher couldn't bear it, and felt that even if he felt wronged, he could not bring down the Lord's face. So he knelt down happily and thanked her, and changed his name from then on.
"Ahem." Black Cloak choked a few times before he regained his breath and raised his eyes to look at Mo Ran, "Huh? Ah Ran? Why are you here?"
Separated by a layer of hazy gauze curtains, those eyes were as soft as spring water, as bright as stars, and they went straight into the heart of Mo Ran.
With just one glance, those tender feelings and boy's thoughts that had been covered in dust for a long time were unblocked in an instant.
This is teacher ignorance.
Can't be wrong.
Mo Ran is a gangster. In his previous life, he played with many men and women. In the end, he did not die of exhaustion. He himself was quite surprised.
But the only person he loved with all his heart, he was cautious and never dared to touch easily.
In those years, he and Shi Mei were romantically involved, but when Shi Mei died, Mo Ran only took his hand and even kissed her once by accident.
Mo Ran felt that he was dirty, and Shi Mei was too gentle and pure, and he was not worthy of it.
He already cherished this person so much while he was alive, let alone after he died. Then he completely became the white moonlight that stepped on the heart of the immortal king. No matter how much he thought about it, this person had become a handful of loess. Under the nine springs, the trace of the fairy was hard to find.
However, at this moment, the living teacher appeared in front of him again, and Mo Ran had to use all his strength to hold back his excited emotions.
Mo Ran helped the man up and dusted him off the cloak, feeling so heartbroken that his flesh dropped.
"If I weren't here, how would you be bullied by them? If someone hits you, why don't you fight back?"
"I want to reason first..."
"How can you reason with these people! Are you hurt? Where does it hurt?"
"Ahem, Ah Ran, I...I'm not in the way."
Mo Ran turned his head and said to the Taoist priests with a ferocious face: "You dare to do it to people on the top of life and death? You are very brave."
"Ah Ran...forget it..."
"Aren't you going to fight? Come on! Why don't you fight me!"
Those Taoist priests were slapped by Mo Ran. They already knew that this person's cultivation level was far above their own. They were all afraid of the hard. They dared to fight against Mo Ran and retreated one after another.
The teacher sighed again and again and advised: "Ah Ran, don't argue, just be merciful and be merciful."
Mo Ran looked back at him, feeling sad and his eyes slightly hot.
Master Mo has always been so kind-hearted. When he died in his previous life, he had no resentment or hatred. He even advised Mo Ran not to remember the person who could obviously save his life.But the Master stood by and watched.
"But they..."
"I'm fine, am I fine? It's better to do less than to do more. Listen to my senior brother."
"Ahem, okay, I'll listen to you, I'll listen to you." Mo Ran shook his head and glared at the Taoist priests, "Did you hear that? My senior brother is interceding for you! Why don't you get out of here? Do you still want me to send you away?"
"Yes, yes! Let's get out of here! Get out of here!"
The teacher said to the Taoist priests, "Wait a minute."
Those few people felt that Shi Mo had just been beaten violently by them, and they felt that he would not let them go easily. They knelt on the ground and kowtowed repeatedly: "Xianjun, Xianjun, we were wrong. We have eyesight but cannot recognize Mount Tai. Please Xianjun, please let us go!"
"I told you carefully just now, but you didn't listen." Shi Mo sighed, "You kidnapped other people's children and suffered such a crime, which made their parents' hearts feel like knives. How can you let go of your conscience?"
"I'm sorry! I'm sorry! Immortal Lord, we were wrong! We never dare to do it again! We never dare to do it again!"
"You must live a clean life in the future and never do evil things again. Do you already know that?"
"Yes! What the Immortal Lord taught is yes! We, we have been taught, we have been taught!"
"In this case, please invite a few people to apologize to this lady and heal her children."
Even if the matter was settled, Mo Ran helped Shi Mo get on the horse, and he borrowed another horse from the post house. The two of them rode slowly together and returned to the sect.
The Wu hook hangs high, and the moonlight passes through the forest leaves and shines on the forest path.
As he walked, Mo Ran gradually became happy: He originally thought that he would have to at least return to the top of life and death before he could see Shi Mei again. Unexpectedly, Shi Mei went down the mountain to help the road, and he happened to bump into him. Mo Ran became more and more convinced that he and Shi Mei were indeed destined.
Although Shi Mo was not with him at this time, he had hooked up with her in his previous life, and it was obvious that he was already familiar with it in this life and it was a matter of course.
The only thing he needs to worry about is to protect Shi Mo and not let him die tragically in his arms like he did back then...
The teacher didn't know that Mo Ran was a reborn person, and chatted with him as before. The two of them chatted and arrived at the foot of the summit of life and death.
Who would have expected that in the middle of the night, there would be a man standing in front of the mountain gate, staring at them eagerly.
"Ink Burning! Do you still know to come back??"
"Huh?"
Mo Ran raised his eyes, oh, what a proud man of heaven with anger.
This person is none other than Xue Meng when he was young.
Compared with the Xue Meng he saw before he died, he looked more unruly and handsome when he was fifteen years old. Wearing a simple armor with black background and blue edges, high ponytail, silver hair buckle, lion head belt tying up a strong and slender waist, hand guards and leg braces, a narrow scimitar with cold light on the back, and a silver quiver in the sleeve of his left arm.
Mo Ran sighed secretly and thought simply:
Yeah, cool.
Xue Meng, no matter when he was a boy or when he grew up, he was really cool.
Look at him, he's such a good guy, staying up late at night, wearing a full set of armor from the Peak of Death and Life, what is he doing? Do pheasants perform courtship and peacocks open their tails?
However, Mo Ran doesn't want to see Xue Meng, and Xue Meng doesn't necessarily want to see him.
Mo Ran is an illegitimate child. When he was a child, he had no idea who his father was and worked in a music studio in Xiangtan. It wasn't until he was fourteen years old that his family found him and brought him back to the pinnacle of life and death.
Xue Meng is the young master at the top of life and death. After all, he is actually Mo Ran's cousin. Xue Meng grew up early and was a genius, known as "The Proud Son of Heaven" and "Phoenix Son". It takes an average person three years to build a foundation, and at least ten years to cultivate a spiritual core. Xue Meng is very talented, and it only takes five years from entry to spiritual core cultivation, which makes his parents happy and he praises him.
But in Mo Ran's eyes, no matter he is a phoenix or a chicken, a peacock or a duck, he is still a bird. It’s just a difference between long hair and short hair.
So Mo Ran looked at Xue Meng: bird thing.
Xue Meng looked at Mo Ran: Dog thing.
Perhaps it is a family inheritance, but Mo Ran's talent is also very amazing, it can even be said that it is more amazing than Xue Meng.
When Mo Ran first came, Xue Meng felt that he was very noble and cool, well-educated, knowledgeable, strong in martial arts, and handsome. He was not the same as his cousin, a stinky hooligan who didn't know a few characters and was carefree.
So the narcissistic Fenghuang'er groaned and commanded his followers, saying to them: "Listen carefully, Mo Ran is idle, uneducated, and an out-and-out street gangster. You are not allowed to talk to him at all. Just treat this person like a dog."
The followers flattered: "What the young master said is very true. That Mo Ran is already fourteen years old, and he has just begun to cultivate immortality. I think it will take him at least ten years to build the foundation, and twenty years to form the spiritual core. By then our young master will have transcended the tribulation and ascended, and he can only watch helplessly on the ground."
Xue Meng sneered proudly: "Twenty years? Humph, I look at his useless appearance, and he will never be able to cultivate a spiritual core in this life."
Who would have expected that the good-for-nothing would learn from his master for a year and actually achieve mastery of his spiritual core.
Phoenix'er suddenly felt like he was struck by lightning. He felt like he had been slapped in the face and couldn't swallow the bad breath.
So he stabbed him secretly, cursed his sword to slip on his feet, and recited curses to tie his tongue.
